summary: Pit-box alignment check on the pit machine: loads a target object from the indexed struct array, computes the relative vector between the machine's transform and the target, applies forward/perpendicular projection tests against the target rotation basis, clears the collision flag and fires a state-change notification when the vehicle is behind and cleared, and returns whether the vehicle is within contact thresholds.

local_names.v28: target rotation basis output of EulerToRotationMatrix

operations.description: ArrayOfStructIndexedFieldCopy(dword_5EA2C0, this->obj+0x48A4 used as index, out v25, out v26) copies the target object's fields for comparison.
F_3DTransformWithMatrixMultiplication computes this object's world transform into v24.
Compute the relative vector between own transform v24 and target v25; squared distance compared against 25.0 selects the close/far branch.
EulerToRotationMatrix(v26, v28) builds the target rotation basis used by the projection tests.
Forward projection v7 = v33*relZ + v31*relY + v29*relX of the relative vector along the target basis.
Return 0 when the forward projection v7 > 1.5 (target outside the forward window).
When v7 < -5.0, SessionCleanupFlagClear(this) clears the collision flag before falling through.
When the perpendicular projection magnitude > 1.5, return 0 unless v7 < 0.
Relative-velocity dot v11 computed from obj velocity fields 0x34C4/0x34D0/0x34DC and compared against the ~0.85 alignment threshold.
On passing the alignment test, when obj 0x32C8 == 0 and dword_7CE7A8 is set, StateChangeNotify(this, 4) fires the collision notification; otherwise return 0.
Slip-velocity magnitude v20 from obj fields 0x34F8/0x34FC/0x3500 must stay under 4.0 (or 0.04 in the far branch) or the function returns 0.
Return 1 when all thresholds pass (contact state), otherwise 0.
